# SCI-JINC To SCI-POINT Boundary

Identity: `SCI-JINC_TO-SCI-POINT-BOUNDARY-REQUIREMENTS v0.1/r0.3`

Status: draft boundary requirements; exact parent authority/version/source
digest not bound; owner approval pending; numerical route unavailable

The boundary admits only signal role
`JINC-SIGNAL/NORMALIZED-JINC-MAP@1`. `N`, `C`, `Q`, and coefficient-squared
temporal accounting remain distinct companions and are not POINT signal
parents. The instantiated boundary binds exact observation and array,
immutable JINC product,
signed estimand, normalization and coefficient method, method/version/
generation, unit/calibration, WCS/grid/frame/tangent basis, support/validity,
missing/non-finite policy, response, covariance/uncertainty,
null/additive-reference state, phase/origin, lifecycle, and provenance.

Instantiation additionally requires exact parent package/version/source digest,
owner approval, and compatibility/supersession state.

It also binds source morphology -> signed/normalized JINC response -> expected
processed-map profile -> Gaussian compatibility, including response center,
model mismatch, expected centroid bias or typed unavailability, fit-domain
relation, and displacement-claim status.

Current numerical state:
`unavailable_pending_method_and_route_binding`. JINC is not silently
equivalent to MAP and is not an automatic substitute or fallback.
